rosterBasis.policy: The user-provided 2026-08-23 CBLOL starter snapshot is the identity basis. Public roster, contract, and profile lag is recorded explicitly instead of silently changing the player set.

semantics.contract: Only a publicly verifiable current expiration date is promoted to endDate. Old-team dates after a transfer, missing dates, salary, buyout, and contract start are excluded.
semantics.career: Public team-history periods with their source precision retained. Public gaps are labelled and not filled by inference.
semantics.honors: Major public team achievements and individual awards; not every minor event, weekly award, or placement.
semantics.prizeMoney: Approximate public cumulative tournament winnings in USD; not salary, bonus, buyout, or market value.
semantics.age: Completed age as of 2026-08-24. Age is null when no exact public birth date is available.
